subtopics.title: Question Walk — Newton's Laws on an Incline

questions.question: The weight component ALONG a 30° incline for a 6 kg block is:
With 70 N up the slope, 29,4 N of gravity component and 8,6 N of friction down it, the net force is:
Friction acts DOWN the slope in this problem because:
options: The block moves up the slope, and kinetic friction opposes the motion
The applied force is too small

questions.question: A net force of 32 N on a 6 kg block gives an acceleration of:

subtopics.title: Question Walk — Momentum, Impulse and the Collision

questions.question: The principle of conservation of linear momentum requires the system to be:
options: Isolated — total linear momentum then remains constant

questions.question: A 4 kg trolley at 3 m·s⁻¹ couples with a stationary 2 kg trolley. The shared velocity is:
Kinetic energy fell from 18 J to 12 J in the coupling. The collision is:
options: Inelastic — kinetic energy was not conserved
Elastic — the trolleys moved after impact

questions.question: The impulse on trolley B (2 kg, from rest to 2 m·s⁻¹) is:
options: 4 N·s — equal and opposite to trolley A's momentum change

questions.question: A ball thrown up at 14,7 m·s⁻¹ reaches the top after:
At the highest point of the flight:
options: Velocity and acceleration are both zero
Velocity is zero; acceleration is still 9,8 m·s⁻² downward
Acceleration is zero; velocity is maximum

questions.question: The maximum height, from v² = vᵢ² − 2gΔy, is 216,09/19,6 =
The velocity at 2,5 s is 14,7 − 9,8 × 2,5 = −9,8 m·s⁻¹, reported as:
options: 9,8 m·s⁻¹ downward — the direction is part of the answer

subtopics.title: Question Walk — Work, Energy and Power

questions.question: Net work on the crate: (90 − 30) N over 8 m =
The work-energy theorem states that net work equals:
options: The total energy of the object

questions.question: 480 = ½ × 15 × v² gives v =
A motor lifts 250 kg through 16 m at constant speed in 25 s. Its power output is:
For an approaching source, the denominator of the Doppler equation:
options: Shrinks — subtract the source speed, so the frequency rises

questions.question: Approaching at 20 m·s⁻¹ with a 900 Hz horn (sound at 340 m·s⁻¹), the listener hears:
After the train passes, the observed frequency 340/360 × 900 =
options: 850 Hz — below the source, as recession demands

questions.question: A medical application of the Doppler effect is:
options: Measuring blood flow speed by ultrasound

subtopics.title: Question Walk — The Circuit with Internal Resistance

questions.question: Two 12 Ω resistors in parallel give:
options: 6 Ω — product over sum, smaller than either branch

questions.question: With external resistance 10 Ω and internal resistance 2 Ω, a 24 V battery drives a main current of:
options: 2 A — emf over the TOTAL resistance, 12 Ω

questions.question: The terminal voltage of the working battery is:
options: 20 V — emf minus the lost volts, 2 × 2

questions.question: The circuit audit that closes the books is:
options: The two branch resistors being equal
The emf equalling the terminal voltage
The power being less than the emf
Branch currents summing to the main current — 1 + 1 = 2 A

questions.question: The work function of a metal is:
options: The MINIMUM energy an electron needs to be emitted from the surface
The average energy of its electrons
The maximum kinetic energy of an ejected electron

questions.question: For 450 nm light, E = hc/λ requires the wavelength entered as:
Photon energy 4,42 × 10⁻¹⁹ J on a metal with W₀ = 3,5 × 10⁻¹⁹ J gives maximum kinetic energy:
options: 9,2 × 10⁻²⁰ J — and positive means emission happens

questions.question: Halving the light's intensity makes the maximum kinetic energy:
options: Stay unchanged — intensity counts photons, frequency sizes them
